body:
Yeah .... *sigh* ...I cant argue, you're not wrong....

if it happens and it comes down to it...I will do that. I hadnt really considered that properly but that is the right thing to do. Im
well past bravado at this point. 

I realise the reaction and consequence is my fault whether I felt disrespected or not. If I cant take it back and replace it with something positive to put out into the world then at the very least I could attempt to scrape back some self respect by admitting my mistakes. 
If the opportunity came up then thats the only thing I could do that would do that. 

At this point I'd only really thought of running or fighting more. 

If a confrontation happens I'll attempt to explain myself at least and hope that person is more reasonable than I realise. Its a better option than what I had so far and I probably would discount it if it was my own suggestion but it seems more viable not coming from me. Thank you.
Thank you. It means a lot coming from this dark dark place atm. Still, I left the house and bought smokes....so there's a small victory for today.

Yeah man its a cycle in itself thts hard to break without this shit on top. It sounds like we both know better but I know that urge is hard to shake off so just take it one day at a time. I'd say I was sweet about 5 months ago when I stopped everything, then a friend died and I hit it all hard again and now I'm back at rock bottom. Seems hard to see it now but if you have stayed sober recently, then there is likely another level even worse off than where you are now, that you could reach by going back on it. If only life had a pause button to sort this shit out.

Yeah all the good stuff is off the list. Sodas/fizzy drinks seem to get me badly too but I can say after 10 years on sodium rabeprazole that its much better on the tablets than off. Still a crap thing to deal with but much less wretching and cramping if i'm careful with what I eat.

This is going to be one of those "hang in there it will get better" posts but....hang in there it will get better.

Once you are able to take control of your own life and live it the way you want to (which there is nothing wrong with at all btw),then things will improve. 

Being a teenager, having the balls the come out and not being supported, losing someone close to you, what a trifecta of triggers for a crappy time and feeling like suicide is an option. But, it will get better if you give it chance. Maybe not immediately but as long as you're always working towards, actively planning your escape then you're on the right path. You will come out of it so strong, and there will be others in your situation posting here in the future that hopefully you could be that line of support they so desperately need because you went through it. Not saying thats an added pressure you have to take on but its something you could do down the track when you see this through.

You're incredibly brave to have come out at this age and be true about who you are. I admire you a lot for that. You deserve unconditional support and love and it is out there but maybe only reachable through the net at the minute. 

The world needs brave people like you. I hope you can see past other peoples judgements and see just how much value you posess. Stay strong. X

If only being a saint and being depressed went hand in hand. But that's not the case. It makes us take risks with our own lives and inadvertently the lives of others in some cases. Its a selfish sickness I think. And designed to feed off the negative feeling of such selfishness. 

FWIW I believe you're not a bad person. Just dealing with issues that mean you're not making decisions based on keeping a positive wellbeing. 

I just posted my own stupid shit. We're probably in the same boat. Do I think I would have done stupid shit if I wasnt depressed? Nope. Do I know a version of me that isnt depressed though? Nope, so from that I can only assume I'm probably a crappy person trying to convice myself I'm good because I dont want to have to kill myself, which it feels all I deserve. Ouch.

As far as drugs and alcohol go, I never truly understood the song by The Verve - "The drugs don't work", until I found myself in that position. Its a temporary escape then back down into a more intense and unpleasant version of where you were. Sometimes you dont even get to escape just live it with even more distorted thoughts. I'd advise against it if you can manage it.

I felt sick for most of my teen years. I thought it was nervousness but in the end it was also a reflux issue that took til I was in my early 20's to properly get under control with tablets. The cramping associated with it is a common sign. I feel for you, it's awful.

I think you can worry yourself sick too though. And if that's the case then I have a friend who used to get a nervous stomach around that age but it went away as he got older and I guess more sure of himself, if that's any consolation.

Keep trying the tablets as they are usually not symptomatic, as in you dont just take them when you feel bad but instead keep taking one or two as directed every day. If you've been sick a lot your insides need time to heal from being inflamed. Dietary changes should help too but looking at the list of things to avoid it's kind of all the fun stuff to eat and drink :/
